scientific_integrity: Analytic stationarity and uniqueness proof, corroborated by standalone exact-rational density and polynomial-moment tests. No independent validation or publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact unrelaxed iid orthogonal-line projections onto the three supporting lines of a nondegenerate acute triangle. The stationary measure is not a least-squares convergence statement; the two-step coupling bound need not be optimal. Publication priority against uninspected specialized sources is unresolved.
title: The unique side-uniform invariant law for randomized Kaczmarz on acute triangles
